selection_basis: Use the recorded Industrial process for the complete white Sculpted faucet with the selected Sculpted layer and support settings.

overhang_recipe.scope: Part cooling is off on ordinary paths. Force 70% only on bridges and wall paths with at least 50% of their bead width unsupported, after the first three bed layers. No layer-time cooling, auxiliary part cooling or fan pre-start.
overhang_recipe.selection_quote: the cooling, high cooling, is totally fine. We can use 100% cooling if we want, but only on the places that actually need it, and everywhere else we shouldn't be using that cooling.

wall_generators: Retain base Arachne for the continuous reinforced foot; other rigid parts retain Classic.
scope: Print process transferred from the accepted black Industrial faucet; white Sculpted physical finish and fit require this complete print.

rear_seam_enforcement.target: Complete Sculpted rear silhouette at every build Z; facets intersecting CAD X=0 +/-0.25 mm
rear_seam_enforcement.physical_result: Industrial reference only; Sculpted seam placement reviewed natively for this print.

tip_rear_seam_enforcement.target: Outer curved neck rear meridian at CAD X=0, excluding plug and display-frame surfaces
tip_rear_seam_enforcement.physical_result: Retain the shared tip rear seam enforcement from the accepted Industrial process.

base_rim_supports.method: dense tree-only rim interface and bridge-only insert recesses
base_rim_supports.scope: The dense tree interface follows the Sculpted ellipse. The mounting recesses use bridges at their shoulders and blind roofs. Finish and removal require a full Sculpted print.

edge_support_strategy.selection_quote: I'm quite convinced that we need to do this everywhere, that we've got these rough edges on overhangs.
edge_support_strategy.method: Follow the visible unsupported edge with a removable fin shaped to that edge; use intermittent arcs on curved rims and retain Tree(auto)/Default on the remaining geometry.
edge_support_strategy.application: The Sculpted tip retains its local fin and anchor treatment. The base rim uses its dense tree interface and continuous first perimeter.

mounting_plate_counterbores.scope: Leave the screw head and shank passages clear. Bridge each counterbore shoulder in the flat mounting plate.

tip_supports.root_contact_scope: Hidden male insertion terminal end only. The directly bonded disc leaves a scuff; do not transfer this bonded contact to visible surfaces.
tip_supports.tree_support_scope: Retain the selected joint-plane block paint and seam-side low lip support enforcers. The inner dispense face uses the separately bounded contact treatment.
tip_supports.selection_quote: That worked. That disc works in this case, and is removable, but it leaves a bit of a scuff that would be a problem on a visible surface, but since its on the male insertion portion that is hidden, we are golden here.

tip_dispense_contact.scope: Carry the dense interface to the inclined inner dispense face. Keep the actual outlet mouth clear for its bridging paths.

annotation_clarification: The 0.24 mm layers are the normal model layers; no separate eight-layer override is necessary when the fine bands are absent.
